currentWork.title: Operational field use — FINAL.22 task targeting and threshold completion verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.22 is merged and production verified. The five remaining top navigation tabs are now forced to share the full row without a leftover empty slot. Task creation keeps the existing all/manufacturer-wide target mode and adds direct single-vending-machine targeting with search. Tasks now have a configurable 1–100% auto-completion threshold, defaulting to 100% for legacy and new tasks. Existing tasks can edit this threshold in Task Detail; completion is triggered when completed target count / current target count reaches or exceeds the threshold. PR #139 merged to main at 0533caa45dab9915a1628377a7543df3ca735efb. PR browser run 37318687576 and main run 37318820245 passed all five gates; GitHub Pages run 37318819474 and Vercel production status passed. Analytics engine/DB/schema remain AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Use five equal-width top navigation tabs with no unused sixth-slot-like gap.
Create tasks for all manufacturers, one manufacturer, or one explicitly selected vending machine.
Search and select a single vending machine directly during task creation.
Set each task's auto-completion threshold from 1% to 100%; default 100% preserves legacy behavior.
Allow the threshold to be changed on existing active tasks from Task Detail.
Auto-complete when completed target count divided by current target count is greater than or equal to the configured threshold.
Show current progress and threshold on task cards/details/history.
Preserve existing per-task target add/remove editing, task completion per machine, visit checks, task history, task/order semantics, Analytics engine, DB and schema.
nextActions: Use the task screen on the phone and confirm the five top tabs visually fill the width.
Create a one-machine task and a percentage task in real use; confirm threshold auto-completion feels correct.
Reopen engineering only for new field friction or explicit product changes.

unresolved: Historical Analytics remains preserved and user-facing Analysis/OCR remains withdrawn; numeric learning promotion remains disabled.
